g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
ion (`name`, `description`, `inputSchema`, ...).\n- [List prompts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-prompts.m
d): Returns the server's prompts as a collection page.\n- [List resources](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-r
esources.md): Returns the server's resources as a collection page.\n- [Read a resource](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/prim
itives/read-a-resource.md): Reads a single resource by URI and returns its contents.\n- [List server skills](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/primitives/list-server-skills.md): Returns the Agent Skills a connected server serves over the MCP skills extensi
on (SEP-2640), including skills it advertises that MCPJam declines to load. Not paginated: the catalog is drained server-side, bec
ause duplicate detection spans the whole listing.\n- [Get a server skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/get-a-s
erver-skill.md): Fetches one skill by URI and verifies it before returning a byte: the SKILL.md digest against the manifest, the f
etched frontmatter against what the listing advertised, and the name against the URI. Reaches skills a partial listing never menti
oned. When a check fails the response carries a `refusal`…\n- [Read a server skill's supporting file](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/primitives/read-a-server-skills-supporting-file.md): Reads one supporting file belonging to a skill, checking its byte l
ength and digest against the skill's own manifest. The manifest is the read allowlist and is re-fetched here rather than accepted
from the caller, so a request cannot authorize its own read.\n- [Export a server snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
xport/export-a-server-snapshot.md): Lists tools, resources, and prompts in one call and returns a single JSON snapshot — handy for
diffing a server's surface over time in CI.\n- [Call a tool](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/call-a-tool.md): Exe
cutes a tool on the server and returns the MCP `CallToolResult` plus an additive `durationMs` (wall-clock time of `executeTool`).
Tool-level failures (`isError: true` in the result) are **successful calls** — the server answered; only transport/auth errors use
the error envelope.\n- [Render a prompt](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-a-prompt.md): Renders a prompt wi
th arguments and returns the MCP `GetPromptResult` directly (`description?`, `messages`).\n- [Render an MCP App widget headlessly]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-an-mcp-app-widget-headlessly.md): Call an MCP App tool and mount its `ui:/
/` widget in real headless Chromium running the production host bridge, then report whether it rendered, what it logged, what it w
as blocked from fetching, and the widget as an accessibility tree with addressable elements.\n- [Create a retained widget session]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/create-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that
created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subjec
t, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Executes the tool and retains its App in one local Chromium context.…\n-
[Read a retained widget snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/read-a-retained-widget-snapshot.md): Available
only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A sessio
n is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Returns an accessibility tree and addre
ssable elements without replay…\n- [Act on a retained widget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/act-on-a-retained-wi
dget.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user
or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one coordinate
action with fresh project/server authorization.\n- [Run a retained widget step](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/r
un-a-retained-widget-step.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requ
ires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout
. Runs one semantic action or assertion, using the same locator vocabul…\n- [Close a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/execution/close-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; h
osted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server
and expires after its idle timeout. Disposes the original owner's browser. Returns closed=false if no mat…\n- [List a suite's sett
ings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entry per committed edit t
o the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many runs were launched agai
nst it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshots. Send a `revisionNum
ber` back…\n- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-env
ironment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not already there.\n- [
List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The accounts this ser
ver signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its project accounts. Ano
ther member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.\n- [Get a server account](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or name. Another member's personal ac
count answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_ambiguo
us\"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.\n- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-ac
counts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-
formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account has creates the
account.\n- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.md): Deletes t
he account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (best effort), whic
h also invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.\n- [Rename a server account or make it the default](https://docs.mcpjam.co
m/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make it the default, or bo
th; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_taken\"`.\n
- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{p
rojectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creating an unnamed on
e when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Su
nse…\n- [List GitHub Checks repositories](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/list-github-checks-repositories.md): The rep
ositories in this organization whose pull requests run an eval suite, plus the repositories the MCPJam GitHub App can reach (the c
hoices a connect has).\n- [Run an eval suite on a repository's pull requests](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/run-an-e
val-suite-on-a-repositorys-pull-requests.md): Connect a repository so every pull request to it runs one eval suite and reports a G
itHub check. **Affects everyone who opens a pull request on that repository**, and with `outagePolicy: fail_closed` it can block t
heir merges.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md
